name: Back Arrow
description: Lingalind çevresi duvarla çevrili bir dünyadır. Lingalind'i çevreleyip, besleyen ve koruyan bu duvarı insanlar tanrı gibi görmektedir. Bir gün kendi ismini dahi unutmuş ve duvarın dışından geldiğini iddia eden bir adam, gökyüzünden Lingalind'in dışlarında yer alan Edger köyüne düşer. Köylülerin Back Arrow dediği bu adam tekrar duvarın dışına gitmek istese de önüne sürekli aşması gereken yeni engeller çıkacaktır.

episodes.name: Do Guys From the Sky Have Undies?
episodes.description: In a world fueled by one’s conviction, one man falls from the sky. He claims to come from beyond the wall, though the world as we know it only exists inside.

episodes.name: Is Having Dreams a Burden?
episodes.description: The strange happenings at Edger Village are starting to be heard across the world. Though Arrow leaves to head for the wall, trouble is coming to find him.

episodes.name: Does a Huge Ship Bring Hope?
episodes.description: Though Elsha discovers a hidden power, the village is ruined for good. To protect everyone and find a new home, a sacrifice must be made.

episodes.name: Does Genius Come When Least Expected?
episodes.description: Shu Bi has been scheming his rise to the top ever since he was little. In order to prove where his loyalties lie, he challenges Arrow with some hired help.

episodes.name: Is Today Yesterday’s Tomorrow?
episodes.description: An old promise between friends is put to the test as their loyalties and ambitions change. But against Rekka’s invincible general, Granedger may not stand a chance.

episodes.name: Are Pretty Boy Farms a Thing?
episodes.description: While Ren Sin vows to unravel Shu Bi’s trickery back in the capital, the crew takes a shortcut to reach the wall quicker and discovers a peculiar farm with a dark past.

episodes.name: Is the Wall Really That Solid?
episodes.description: All eyes are on the Granedger as it closes in on the wall to destroy it. While Rekka waits for the right chance to strike, Shu Bi pulls out the big guns.

episodes.name: What is the Bloodstained Knight Hiding?
episodes.description: Arrow stays behind to fight the wall while the rest of the village heads to Lutoh. Though at first it seems like paradise, this nation full of love hides dark secrets, too.

episodes.name: Why Do Lips that Profess Love Hide Fangs?
episodes.description: Prax will stop at nothing to kill anyone who knows Princess Fine’s secret. In Rekka, Emperor Zetsu puts on a show and makes a surprising declaration.

episodes.name: Can Have-Nots Have Backbone?
episodes.description: As Lutoh prepares for war, the princess turns her eyes to the Granedger and Elsha who steers it. To survive, Elsha must take a stand for herself and her people.

episodes.name: Is This a Head-to-Head Fight?
episodes.description: With war on the horizon, Lutoh and Granedger prepare to fight Rekka. As battle erupts, Ren Sin and Kai rush to kill the traitor, but Arrow and friends stand in their way.

episodes.name: Is Too Much Pride a Problem?
episodes.description: War has begun and both sides have had casualties. Thirsty for revenge, Ren Sin and Kai are desperate to get stronger, but must find it in themselves to grow.

episodes.name: Do the Heavens Cry When the Princess Rises?
episodes.description: The wound on Arrow's hand makes it hard for him to fight. With their strategy to bury Rekka struggling to succeed, Lutoh's princess is tempted to join the fray.

episodes.name: Is There Love on the Battlefield?
episodes.description: Emperor Zetsu goes head-to-head against the berserk side of Princess Fine. As she loses touch with love, the princess doesn't discern between friend and foe.

episodes.name: What Will the Riots Produce?
episodes.description: There's chaos in the capital when Princess Fine returns from war. Due to some trickery, the citizens of Lutoh have turned against her and are demanding the princess' head.

episodes.name: When People Want Peace, What Does God Want?
episodes.description: Granedger hosts a signing ceremony to become an independent nation. As the world's powers gather on the ship, Arrow and Shu visit Rekka for some awkward diplomacy.

episodes.name: Böyle mi Yükseliyorlar?
episodes.description: Uçan bir dretnot yeterince şaşırtıcı değilmiş gibi, Lind Faithten gizemli bir cüppeli figür, Arrowu duvarın ötesine, dünyanın gerçeğini bir kez ve herkes için ortaya çıkarmaya davet ediyor.

episodes.name: Bu Dünyanın Gerçeği mi?
episodes.description: Granedgerın ekibi, dünyalarının gerçeğini öğrendiğinde şok olsa da, bazı oyuncular başından beri biliyordu. Arrow, arkadaşlarının yardımıyla kendi kaderiyle savaşır.

episodes.name: Bunu Sıralayabilir misin?
episodes.description: Korkusuzları duvarların içinde sıkışıp kalırken Shu, Arrowun öfkesini dünyayı yok etmeden önce durdurmak için bir strateji formüle eder.

episodes.name: Beni Kim Durduracak?
episodes.description: Bit savaşa katılır ve Shu'nun gizli silahını serbest bırakır. Ama Rudolph ciddileştiğinde, Lingalind'in güçleri Tanrı'nın yardım elini devirmek için gerekenlere sahip mi?

episodes.name: Ama Ne İçin Yaşıyorum?
episodes.description: Shunun büyük kumarı, hayati bilgilerle geri döndüğünde meyvelerini verir. Ancak mürettebat Tanrıya meydan okumadan önce, Kainin Arrowla hesaplaşması gereken bir hesabı vardır.

episodes.name: 24. Bölüm
